user.title: E.ON Sweden – Log in
user.description:
{addon_status}

Enter your E.ON credentials. If the add-on is installed it will log in automatically. Without the add-on, use the browser login method instead.

data.addon_url: Auth add-on URL (leave blank to auto-detect)

browser_login.title: E.ON Sweden – Browser login (manual fallback)
browser_login.description:
**Step 1 –** Open this link in your browser and log in:

[Open E.ON login]({auth_url})

**Step 2 –** After login your browser URL will show:
`https://www.eon.se/?code=XXXXX&state=...`

Paste the full URL **or** just the `code=` value below.

data.auth_code: Auth code or full redirect URL from browser

facilities.title: Select facilities
facilities.description: Choose which metering facilities to include.

error.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code — open the login link again and paste the new code.
error.addon_unreachable: Cannot reach the auth add-on at this URL. Check it is installed and running.
error.addon_not_running: E.ON Auth add-on not detected. Make sure it is installed, started, and shows 'Running' in the add-on Info tab.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to E.ON Sweden. Check your internet connection.
error.playwright_missing: Playwright is not installed. Install the E.ON Auth add-on instead.

abort.already_configured: This E.ON account is already configured.
